verdict.rationale: Sentry's own AI layer, Seer, automatically scans incoming issues to find root causes and automate triage. Seer Agent also answers questions by finding the relevant telemetry, which gives responders AI-generated context on issues. The docs never explicitly describe an incident or alert summary, nor AI context attached to alert notifications. missing for 10: explicit AI-generated incident summaries, AI context embedded in alerts or notifications for responders, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders

citations.quote: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage.
Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
